name: Leveraged Covered Call on Margin
summary: A buy-write where the shares are purchased on Reg-T margin, roughly doubling both the yield on equity and the drawdown. FLAGGED: high risk for an automated system.
max_profit: same dollar max profit as a cash buy-write but on half the equity, so ~2x return on equity, less margin interest
max_loss: same dollar loss on ~half the equity, so ~2x drawdown; margin call risk below maintenance
breakevens: share price - credit + accrued margin interest per share

greeks.delta: +70 per unit, but ~+140 per dollar of equity

when_to_use: Rarely justified. Only on very low-beta, high-liquidity ETFs, with total portfolio margin usage capped. FLAGGED: leverage plus a capped upside is an asymmetric bad trade - the cap stays, the losses double.
entry_rules: Only enable if account is a margin account and total gross exposure <= 1.5x equity.
Require the underlying's 1-year max drawdown x leverage < 35% of account equity.
Require the call credit annualized to exceed the margin interest rate by >= 6 percentage points.
Maintain maintenance excess >= 35% of equity at all times.
management_rules: Deleverage first on any drawdown: if maintenance excess < 30%, sell shares (after buying back a proportional number of calls) before doing anything else.
Never add leverage to defend a loser.
exit_rules: Hard assignment guard as per covered call, plus: exit the whole unit if maintenance excess < 25%.
Always buy back calls before liquidating shares so cover is never broken.
assignment_risk: Same as covered call, with the added hazard that assignment removes the shares while the margin loan remains until settlement, temporarily distorting buying power.
buying_power: ~50% of share notional as Reg-T initial; maintenance typically 25-30%.
common_mistakes: Treating the capped-upside covered call as a levered growth vehicle; getting margin-called in the drawdown that the call premium barely cushioned.
zero_dte_notes: Do not combine leverage with 0DTE gamma.
family: Stock/ETF Shares Combined With Options (covered writes, protective hedges, collars, synthetics, repairs, conversions)
